newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria bought 150,000 tonnes soft wheat - official.
newsitem.headline: Algeria bought 150,000 tonnes soft wheat - official.

text.p: Algeria has bought a total of 150,000 tonnes of soft wheat -- 125,000 from the French market under an export-guaranteed credit and 25,000 optional -- for delivery between February 25 and the first half of March, an Algerian official said on Thursday.
"Only one cargo was optional and the others were French," said a senior official in the Algerian Office Interprofessionnel des Cereales (OAIC), speaking by telephone from Algiers.
The official declined to give more details, including prices.
The 125,000 tonnes of French soft wheat were covered by a French Coface-guaranteed export credit.
